q1_issues.issue: "Conference Board economist Ken Goldstein" is encoded as (Past (PartOf ken_goldstein conference_board)), but the proper-noun-premodifier rule licenses only the opaque Possession and explicitly forbids inventing membership or PartOf the words do not state.

(Of sk_end_1 sk_recession_1) is asserted at top level although "the end of the recession" is stated only inside the sealed quotation; the projection table keeps a referent's Of restrictor sealed and projects only Member/Name typing.

The stated measured gap "almost a year and a half after the end of the recession" is reduced to a bare (Before sk_end_1 sk_point_1), dropping the magnitude the licensed BeforeBy <n> <unit> form would carry.

q2_gaps: an of-phrase naming an event noun's underlying INTRANSITIVE SUBJECT ("the end of the recession" — the recession ends): of-phrases are routed as the nominalization's OBJECT (the Of oblique), and the subject-argument route is given only for genitives ("Marta's objection")

an approximator on a measured temporal gap ("almost a year and a half after X"): the hedge-to-sigma table covers only about/around/approximately/roughly, and "almost" is defined elsewhere as a property-cancelling approximator with no magnitude reading
notes: The rest follows doctrine: say takes Experiencer with a sealed Theme, the past host clause wraps the appositive typing, the participial modifier stays the adjective "improved", and the indefinite recovery's witness stays inside the seal. Projecting (Member sk_reading_1 improved) is defensible since "the improved reading" is the reporter's own pre-quotation description rather than a sealed predication.
